messages:
Maya R: Kicking off bring-up for kairos-13b-v2 (quant int4) canary. Seeing intermittent OOMs with defaults (batch=8, max_new_tokens=512). Opening thread to coordinate fixes.
Samir: I saw the spikes on the perf dashboard — memory trends shoot up around step ~45, looks correlated with long-seq requests and prefetch churn.
ops-bot: Deploy event: canary/kairos-13b-v2-int4 started (id=canary-2025-11-03-09).
Maya R: Quick repro locally: lowering batch to 4 and enabling slot-cushion=0.15 drops the OOMs but p95 latency increases ~12%. Need tradeoffs.
Tito: Suggest trying max_new_tokens default -> 256 and enable adaptive-batching (target_latency=160ms). Also set kv-trim-threshold=0.6 so we trim cold KV slots earlier.
Samir: Ran a smoke run with batch=4, max_new_tokens=256, kv-trim=0.6: stable for ~5k requests, no OOMs. Fragmentation still creeping (heap fragmentation + small free slabs).
Rupa: Fragmentation pattern looks like many short/long sequence interleaves causing small-slab churn from prefetch. Proposal: heap-shrink-window=3 and prefetch-window-gamma=0.8 to smooth allocation bins.
Maya R: Patching canary now: heap-shrink-window=3, prefetch-window=0.8, batch_pacing=0.6. Logs (snippet): ```[INFO] canary:kairos-v2 | kv_slots=1024 free=128 frag=17% | heap_shrink=3 | prefetch_gamma=0.8```
Samir: Post-patch run (3h): 0 OOMs. p50 latency +6%, p95 +11%. Throughput down ~9%. Good stability but latency footprint heavier — fine for Dedicated, not for Hosted.
Maya R: Proposed rollout policy: for Hosted tier, auto-fallback to int8 model variant if frag > 20% OR reduce max_new_tokens to 128 dynamically. For Dedicated, keep int4 with slower batch defaults. I'll draft an RFC with rollback guards.
Tito: Also add a canary eval: run the prompt-set 'safety_and_instr' and 'customer-chat-small' to detect any INT4 quality regressions before broad rollout.
Rupa: I'll wire an alert: metric "mem_frag_percent" > 18% for 5m triggers canary rollback + slack paging. Adding dashboard tile for frag vs p95 and kv-trim events.
Maya R: Thanks — ops keep the canary running overnight, will collect a 24h run and perf/eval snapshots. If all good, we'll do a staged rollout with fallback rules.
Samir: Noted. Also saved the experiment config: `rls set --model kairos-13b-v2 --batch 4 --max_new_tokens 256 --kv_trim 0.6 --heap_shrink 3 --prefetch_gamma 0.8`. Will attach perf traces to the RFC.
Rupa: :thumbsup: I'll add the regression checks and alert runbook (playbook link soon).
Maya R: Closing the loop tomorrow AM with quantitative results and a recommended rollout window.
